applies_to.notes: Only CLI 2.1.296; failure-isolated synchronous/asynchronous logging from native JS synthetic tests. Supersedes deprecated K-0036; no model-origin runnable-code acceptance or later CLI guarantee.

evidence.notes: First-party pinned M004 supports tool.call middleware/next(e) invariant. Node v24 safe synthetic fixtures on Mac independently tested downstream returned value and error identity despite both synchronous logger throw and Promise.reject, specifically guarded with awaited Promise.resolve(logger()). GitHub PR #43 reviewers found the original K-0036 example did not await Promise-returning diagnostics; that old approved record was deprecated by append-only state transition, not rewritten. Safe synthetic CLI 2.1.296 strict static validation passed; generated model code was NOT executed or certified.

statement: Claude Code CLI 2.1.296 的透明 `tool.call` 观察器应该将诊断操作与下游工具结果完全隔离：最小安全形式是直接 `return next(e)`。如果必须记录日志，`next(e)` 只能调用一次，且诊断失败不应替换原始返回值或异常。为捕获同步抛错及异步诊断 Promise 拒绝，独立的日志保护块应在 `try { return await next(e); } finally { try { await Promise.resolve(console.log("observer done")); } catch { /* 仅忽略诊断失败 */ } }` 中等待日志完成。不可在 `finally` 中直接调用未保护的日志（即使已 `await next(e)`），也不可在 `catch(error)` 中调用可能覆盖原始异常的日志。如果诊断 API 返回 Promise，仅有未带 `await` 的普通 `try/catch` 不足以捕获后续 rejection。以上 console.log 只表示 JavaScript 日志写法，不保证任何 Mods 专用日志 API 存在；目标CLI之外的兼容性及真实用户代码的运行结果仍需单独核验。
subject: mods.events.fail-isolated-transparent-observer-diagnostics-async-safe
